title: QFEP Classification
description: Map an artifact to its position in E = F + lambda * phi * dE. Category determines the QFEP connection string.

nodes.label: Read the artifact category and algorithm type
Pure F — predictable, structured
nodes.detail: primitives, transforms, geometry. Form that yields behavior.

nodes.label: Classical F — force as law
nodes.detail: forces, physics, joints. Constraint rules producing motion.

nodes.label: E(S) — entropy as source
nodes.detail: randomness, noise. Raw disorder filtered through structure.

nodes.label: Lambda — tuning between order and chaos
nodes.detail: fractals, L-systems. The parameter that controls complexity.

nodes.label: Phi*dE — rate of change
nodes.detail: morphogenesis, swarm, growth. How systems evolve over time.

nodes.label: Edge of chaos — critical lambda
nodes.detail: cellular automata, emergence. The phase transition between order and disorder.

summary: primitives→F, randomness→E(S), fractals→λ, morphogenesis→φdE, forces→Classical F, CA→Edge of chaos.
